read_me_first.headline: Stance: RISK OFF. SPY is below its short-term lines on both the daily and weekly charts — the index is in a downtrend.
because: SPY is below its short-term lines on both the daily and weekly charts — the index is in a downtrend.

SPY sits -2.42 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). QQQ sits -2.81 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). VIX/VIX3M is 1.41, above 1.00 — the options market is pricing near-term uncertainty.
Real leadership this week: Cyber Security, Edge Cloud, Life Science Tools & Services — strong on both the weekly and monthly read.
read_me_first.so_what: Breadth is against the tape — build the watchlist, do not push new entries.
caveats: DATA NOT CURRENT (expected session 2026-11-23): dispersion_vixeq as of 2026-11-20 [PUBLISHER_LAG]; dspx as of 2026-11-20 [PUBLISHER_LAG]. Readings that depend on them are older than today's close.
read_me_first.note: Rule-based reading, not a prediction — see docs/AQE_VALEN_DASHBOARD_PROPOSAL.md.

gex.commentary: Below flip: moves get amplified. Cut size, tighten stops.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
gex.dealer_read: Volatile market — dealers are short gamma and amplify moves in both directions: support ~700, breakout level ~741 (reclaiming it calms the market), resistance ~775.
